title: Root-moment rigidity for the Lai-Sprang Littlewood series in Lean 4
description:
Lean 4 formalisation of root-moment rigidity and the forced-factor step in a parity descent for the Lai-Sprang function-field Littlewood series. Includes exact-certificate soundness, named coefficient streams, polynomial/Laurent coefficient and fractional-product bridges, and reproducible exact finite-field experiments.

The included ordinary proof establishes the auxiliary all-shift bound j-d <= N for d < N(N-1), with N=2^v_2(p-1). This cutoff is not yet an end-to-end Lean theorem: the root enumeration, coefficient-window-to-moment derivation and complete descent remain separate obligations. The all-degree auxiliary bound and characteristic-two frontier remain unresolved.

The parity/Vandermonde/nonsquare method is attributed to Li Lai and Johannes Sprang, arXiv:2606.00633v1, Section 3. First-formalisation priority and independent human peer review are not claimed. OpenAI Codex was used extensively under Greg Baker's research direction. See NOTICE and releases/v0.1.0.md for provenance, exact hypotheses and reproduction instructions.
